subject: Onboarding evidence bundle: training attestations + background checks
content:
From: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.s@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding evidence for SOC2 fieldwork

Hi Alex,

Greenfield's external auditor starts SOC2 field work the week of March 20. They asked us to provide sample onboarding artifacts for employees with access to production systems. Specifically:
- Training completion roster (security, data handling) for last 12 months
- Evidence that background checks were completed / vendor attestations
- Onboarding/offboarding checklist showing deprovisioning timelines

Can you share a bundle (redacted PII) and a short note on the retention/verification process? If you have a canonical runbook or template, that would be helpful.

Thanks,
Rajiv
--
Rajiv Singh
Director, Compliance Ops
Greenfield Health

-----Original Message-----
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.s@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding evidence for SOC2 fieldwork

Rajiv — thanks for the heads up. We can assemble a bundle and include:
- Redacted training roster CSV (last 12 months) with completion dates and course IDs
- Vendor attestation from Sterling for background checks + redacted summary PDF
- Our onboarding runbook (internal) that maps steps to identity & access actions
- A short process note on how we verify and retain records (S3 + access logs)

I'll pull the artifacts and send them over by EOD Friday. We will redact candidate DOBs/SSNs per your guidance.

Alex

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding evidence for SOC2 fieldwork

Quick notes from HR side:
- Sterling background checks completed for roles with prod access; we keep vendor attestations for 7 years per policy.
- We can provide a redacted summary (no PII) that lists check type, completed date, and verification token.
- For hires older than 18 months we may only have archive links; I will surface the export.

Marissa and Laura — can you confirm who will run the redaction and which fields to remove?

-Karthik

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Mar 2028 11:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Request: onboarding evidence for SOC2 fieldwork

Forwarding to HR ops (Laura) for the redaction run and to prepare the artifacts. Proposed redaction fields: DOB, SSN/NI, home address, personal email. Keep employee ID, role, hire date, training completion date.

Attachments: training-attestation-templates.docx (template), onboarding-runbook-2028-03.md (draft)

Marissa

-----Original Message-----
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.s@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 14:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Onboarding evidence bundle (redacted) — attached / links

Rajiv — attaching the sanitized bundle for initial review. Summary below:  
- employee-training-roster-2027.csv (redacted): course IDs, completion dates, employee ID, role.
- bg-check-summary-redacted.pdf: vendor attestation + per-employee redacted token (no PII).
- onboarding-runbook-2028-03.md: internal steps mapping to IAM and provisioning actions.
- training-attestation-templates.docx: template we use for contractors.

We uploaded the original artifacts to our scoped Drive folder and shared a viewer link (see below). If auditors need signed vendor letters, Sterling can produce a scoped attestation — I copied their support contact below for the request.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B1redwood/onboarding-evidence-2028
DocuSign envelope for contractor attestations: https://app.docusign.com/greenfield/Envelope/12345

Please review and tell us if you need anything else before March 20.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments included: employee-training-roster-2027.csv, bg-check-summary-redacted.pdf, onboarding-runbook-2028-03.md, training-attestation-templates.docx

-----Original Message-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding evidence bundle (redacted) — attached / links

Thanks — I ran the redaction pass and validated archive links for hires >18 months. Notes:
- All production-access roles have a corresponding background-check token from Sterling.
- Retention: HR retains vendor attestations and redaction manifests in a locked S3 bucket for 7 years; access requires approvals and is audited monthly.
- Deprovisioning SLA: account disable within 2 hours of termination ticket, full account removal within 3 business days (evidence included in runbook).

I'll upload the final redaction log to the Drive folder and send the auditor-facing cover note this afternoon.

Laura Bennett
HR Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

[End of thread]
